BackstoryDef.title: Rainfield farmhand
BackstoryDef.description: They learned to work fields battered by heavy rains and sudden coastal storms.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm forge apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Weapons, tools, hinges, and nails all passed through the forge where they spent their youth.

BackstoryDef.title: Fortress laborer's child
BackstoryDef.description: Raised around thick walls and hard stone, they learned why Stormlands builders rarely trusted delicate structures.

BackstoryDef.title: Rainwood carver
BackstoryDef.description: They carved figures from dark Rainwood timber during long evenings when storms kept everyone indoors.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm lord's ward
BackstoryDef.description: Living in another House's castle taught them loyalty, pride, and the direct manners common among storm lords.

BackstoryDef.title: Heir beneath the storm
BackstoryDef.description: Prepared to inherit a hard land, they learned stores, defenses, tenants, and the duties owed to sworn men.

BackstoryDef.title: Second son of the Marches
BackstoryDef.description: A younger son near the Dornish Marches often found more opportunity with sword and horse than ledger and plow.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm bastard
BackstoryDef.description: Born outside marriage, they developed a stubborn independence well suited to the Stormlands.

BackstoryDef.title: Rainwood hunter
BackstoryDef.description: They tracked game through thick wet forests where visibility vanished whenever the rain grew heavy.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm knight's page
BackstoryDef.description: They followed a household knight through training yards and skirmishes, learning both swordplay and battlefield first aid.

BackstoryDef.title: Stormland crofter
BackstoryDef.description: Unpredictable weather taught them to grow hardy crops and preserve whatever the storms did not destroy.

BackstoryDef.title: Marches weaponsmith
BackstoryDef.description: Generations of border conflict ensured a constant demand for spearheads, swords, armor, and repairs.

BackstoryDef.title: Fortress mason
BackstoryDef.description: Inspired by castles like Storm's End, they prefer walls thick enough to challenge both armies and weather.

BackstoryDef.title: Rainwood huntsman
BackstoryDef.description: They made their living among boar, deer, hounds, and the dense forests of the Rainwood.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm hall carver
BackstoryDef.description: They decorated keeps with antlers, storm motifs, ships, and scenes of legendary battles.

BackstoryDef.title: Marches healer
BackstoryDef.description: Border fighting gave them more experience treating wounds than any village healer would have wished for.

BackstoryDef.title: Castle lorekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: They kept records of oaths, marriages, border claims, and the endless disputes of neighboring Houses.

BackstoryDef.title: Stormland knight
BackstoryDef.description: Hard fighting and hard weather produced a soldier who values strength and endurance over ceremony.

BackstoryDef.title: Storm castellan
BackstoryDef.description: They managed a fortress where preparedness for siege and bad weather were equally important.

BackstoryDef.title: Marcher envoy
BackstoryDef.description: Years dealing with proud storm lords and neighboring Dornish Houses taught them when diplomacy could prevent another border war.
